_source: Captured 2026-09-07 from a real audit on production: test-fixtures/fake-bill.pdf + fake-eob.pdf (TESTING.md plan E1), run against gemini-3.6-flash with no plan on file. The bill and the patient are synthetic — Jane Q. Testpatient at St. Verification General Hospital — which is why this can be published. Only the three fields renderReport() reads are kept; the stored audit's bill/eob document text, patientName, statementId, tokens and timestamps are deliberately absent. Do not hand-edit the figures: their value is that a real run produced them.

findings.description: Code 80053 (Comprehensive metabolic panel) is billed twice on the itemized bill for $145.50 each on 06/12/2026, but only one unit was submitted to or processed on the EOB.

evidence.billQuote:
1 80053 Comprehensive metabolic panel 1 $145.50
2 80053 Comprehensive metabolic panel 1 $145.50

findings.description: The provider billed the patient $845.00, which exceeds the EOB determined patient responsibility of $186.35.

evidence.billQuote: PATIENT BALANCE DUE: $845.00 — payable within 30 days

findings.description: The EOB's per-line patient responsibility amounts sum to $168.35 ($8.24 + $4.55 + $124.00 + $27.70 + $3.86), but the EOB states the total patient responsibility as $186.35, an internal error of $18.00.
